name: Bamboo Grove
summary:
After your friend, Ai Yi, returned to her hometown, all contact with her was lost. To find any trace of her, you venture alone to a village hidden deep within a bamboo forest. But everything here is unnervingly strange—muttering elders with vacant stares, deathly pale paper figures that move on their own, and a colossal shadow stirring in the darkness… As bizarre phenomena unfold one after another, will you choose to flee, or will you press on to uncover the horrifying truth behind the village?
